headline: 75 killed in Khulna this year amid surge in extortion and gang violence
summary: Extortion and gang violence have led to a sharp increase in killings in Khulna, with 75 deaths reported so far this year. Authorities are struggling to contain the escalating crime.
details: Khulna has witnessed a disturbing rise in fatalities this year, with 75 people killed primarily due to escalating extortion and gang violence. The grim statistics highlight a growing law and order crisis in the region.

Local reports indicate that criminal gangs are increasingly involved in extortion rackets, leading to violent confrontations and a surge in homicides. The situation has created an atmosphere of fear among residents.
Authorities are reportedly intensifying efforts to combat the rising crime wave, but the persistent violence suggests a significant challenge in restoring peace and security to Khulna.

topic: fire destroys homes of poor fishing and farming families in Sunamganj
headline_marked: 13 families [[left homeless after fire]] in Sunamganj village
headline: 13 families left homeless after fire in Sunamganj village
summary: Poor fishermen and farmers in Jarolia village lost everything in a sudden blaze that destroyed 13 homes overnight.
details: A devastating fire destroyed the homes of 13 families in Jarolia village, under the Sormongol Union of Dirai Upazila in Sunamganj.
The blaze broke out around 8 PM on Monday night and raged for approximately two hours before local residents managed to bring it under control.
Residents reported that because the houses were built close together, the fire spread rapidly from one home to another, destroying furniture, clothing, and stored grain.
The affected families are primarily poor fishermen and farmers who have now been left destitute after losing their only shelter and belongings.
While no casualties or injuries were reported, the victims expressed their desperation, stating they cannot afford to rebuild their homes without external aid.
Dirai Upazila Nirbahi Officer (UNO) Sanjib Sarkar visited the site and stated that the process of assessing the total damage is underway.
Local authorities have assured the affected families that they will receive the necessary assistance to recover from the loss.
